local users = tool('list_users', {})
local user_ids = {}
for _, u in ipairs(users) do
  user_ids[#user_ids + 1] = u.id
end

local dates = {'2026-06-15', '2026-06-16', '2026-06-17', '2026-06-18', '2026-06-19'}

-- For each date, collect busy intervals per user
local all_busy_by_date = {}
for _, date in ipairs(dates) do
  local busy_lists = {}
  for _, uid in ipairs(user_ids) do
    local avail = tool('get_availability', {user_id = uid, date = date})
    busy_lists[#busy_lists + 1] = avail.busy or {}
  end
  all_busy_by_date[date] = busy_lists
end

-- Helper: convert HH:MM to minutes from midnight
local function to_mins(t)
  local h, m = t:match('^(%d+):(%d+)$')
  return tonumber(h) * 60 + tonumber(m)
end

local function to_hhmm(mins)
  local h = math.floor(mins / 60)
  local m = mins % 60
  return string.format('%02d:%02d', h, m)
end

-- Working hours: 09:00-17:00, meeting 60 min, start on 30-min boundary
-- Possible starts: 09:00, 09:30, ..., 16:00
local possible_starts = {}
for m = 9*60, 16*60, 30 do
  possible_starts[#possible_starts + 1] = m
end

local function intervals_overlap(start1, end1, start2, end2)
  return start1 < end2 and start2 < end1
end

local function is_free(busy_list, start_m, end_m)
  for _, b in ipairs(busy_list) do
    local bs = to_mins(b.start)
    local be = to_mins(b['end'])
    if intervals_overlap(start_m, end_m, bs, be) then
      return false
    end
  end
  return true
end

-- Find earliest slot
for _, date in ipairs(dates) do
  local busy_lists = all_busy_by_date[date]
  for _, start_m in ipairs(possible_starts) do
    local end_m = start_m + 60
    local all_free = true
    for _, bl in ipairs(busy_lists) do
      if not is_free(bl, start_m, end_m) then
        all_free = false
        break
      end
    end
    if all_free then
      local start_iso = date .. 'T' .. to_hhmm(start_m) .. ':00Z'
      local end_iso = date .. 'T' .. to_hhmm(end_m) .. ':00Z'
      return {start = start_iso, ['end'] = end_iso, users = user_ids, debug_busy = all_busy_by_date[date]}
    end
  end
end

return {error = 'no slot found', users = user_ids, busy = all_busy_by_date}
